ev.q: One recall letter was sent to parents of 438 (50%) eligible children selected randomly.
32% of children whose parents were sent letters were known to have completed the study vaccination series
139 (32%) of the children whose parents had been sent a recall letter had completed the study vaccination series
The county of residence was categorized as rural or frontier for 87% of participants.
not significantly different from the 28% of children who were vaccinated but whose parents had not been sent letters
Likewise, no significant differences were found when cohorts were stratified by county of residence
